TO GET TIMELY UPDATES ON JOB OPENINGS, FEEL FREE TO JOIN OUR COMMUNITY @ (4L+ MEMBERS FROM 35+ COUNTRIES)﻿ ﻿
 Looking for a QA Engineer with 0 to 1 year of experience and knowledge in automation testing tools. 
 They are someone who is currently living in Tamil Nadu or Kerala and can start immediately or have 30 days notice period. 
 Role Description: 

 As a Quality Assurance Engineer' they will be responsible for the planning and implementation of tests that prove the functional and non-functional requirements of the system. They will be working alongside other engineers and developers working on different layers of the infrastructure. 
 Job Responsibilities: 

• Provide technical knowledge and lead the team 

• Perform software testing 

• Create and run tests/troubleshooting 

• Find bugs and resolve them 

• Resolve issue faced by real time customers 

• Knowledge of latest technologies 

 Mandatory Requirements: 

• Knowledge in Agile technology and testing concepts 

• Understanding end to end test management workflow 

• Knowledge of tools like JIRA, ALM, TESTRAIL, BUGZILLA, HP 

 Preferred Requirements: 

• Familiar with relevant QA industries standard practices and methodologies 

• Knowledge of cypress and selenium tools. 

• Ability to manage a small team of 2 team members. 

 Qualities: 

• Traits to lead team and deliver work end to end, including testing and customer satisfaction 

• Must have good interpersonal skills to interact with various teams. 

• Respect for deadlines 

• Passionate about working and creating a great product 

• Good communication skills 

 Eligibility Criteria: 

• 0-1 years of testing experience. 

• Bachelors / BE / BTech. / Masters in Technology. 

 What's for the candidate: 

• Best-in-class packages 

• Paid holidays and flexible paid time away 

• Casual dress code & flexible working environment 

• Medical Insurance covering self & family up to 4 lakhs per person 

 Job Location: Remote/WFH, ﻿Kerala or Tamil Nadu candidates only 
 Note: For our vision, our Flagship Event ' IAC VISION 2030 ' would provide employment and career opportunities for millions of job-ready interns, freshers and professionals in our Industry Academia Community (IAC). 
 By submitting your application you confirm that you are a member of IAC or give your consent to add you to the IAC platform as a member of Industry Academia Community.﻿﻿
